notes: ACCESS: HTTP tier 1 sufficient -- curl_cffi Session with impersonate='chrome124' (visit homepage first for cookies, then GET each listing URL). A bare/no-session request to any Flipkart URL including robots.txt returns the reCAPTCHA interstitial (confirmed: plain curl/requests both hit it), but the same request through a warmed curl_cffi Chrome-impersonation session returns full SSR HTML with HTTP 200 every time -- no Playwright/Claude-in-Chrome needed. ROBOTS.TXT: fetched via the working session, HTTP 200, 3111 bytes. No anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry anywhere; only generic 'User-agent: *' disallows on tracking/facet/review/cart paths (/viewcart, /dynamic/, /reviews/, /ps/, /sc/, URL-parameter facet/sort variants) plus named allowances for Googlebot-Image/Adsbot-Google/Mediapartners-Google/Storebot-Google. No blanket Disallow: / for anyone. Proceeded normally per Rule 3. TREE SOURCE: Flipkart's dedicated bathroom-fixtures department is NOT under /home-decor/ (that tree, covered by the prior Home-Decor pass archive c265, is decor-only: mirrors/wall-decor/lighting, already excluded here as out-of-scope duplicates of Wall Decor / Lighting workbooks). The real Bathroom tree lives in two separate departments, found via a Flipkart site-search's own CATEGORIES filter facet (searching 'toilet seat', 'faucet' etc. surfaced the department breadcrumb): (1) 'Building Materials and Supplies' > 'Bathroom and Kitchen Fittings' (sid=b8s,ecr) -- fetched its own listing page and extracted the FULL 35-node child list from an embedded JSON array ({id,title,totalProduct,uri}) present in the raw HTML even though the rendered UI collapses most behind 'Show 30 more' (same pattern as the Furniture pass's 'Show 12 more'); (2) 'Home Cleaning & Bathroom Accessories' (sid=rja) > 'Bathroom Accessories' (sid=rja,zqm, 9 children, also fully present in raw HTML behind a 'Show 3 more' toggle). QTY VERIFICATION: the embedded facet JSON's own 'totalProduct' field was checked against the rendered listing-page header ('Showing 1-40 of N products') on every leaf and found UNRELIABLE in both directions (e.g. Hair Wash Basins: JSON totalProduct=14, real page header=168; most other nodes' JSON figures were also far below the real header count). Per Rule 1/2, qty on every recorded row is the rendered header figure from a direct fetch of that row's own URL, not the facet JSON. EXCLUSIONS (not recorded, not reviewed -- confirmed via product-title sampling, not guessed): Kitchen Sinks (b8s,ecr,d2r) and Tap Mount Water Filters (b8s,ecr,vm9) -- kitchen-only, no bathroom content. Shelf Brackets (b8s,ecr,5i8) -- sampled titles are generic AC-unit/wall-mount brackets, not bathroom-specific. Flanges (b8s,ecr,d5k) -- sampled titles are agricultural/industrial non-return-valve flanges, not bathroom. Hair Wash Basins (b8s,ecr,ww5) -- node is mislabeled/mistagged: of the sampled titles, the overwhelming majority are generic kitchen/bathroom sink drain hair-catchers and strainers (not basins at all); only 1-2 of ~15 sampled were actual basin products, so the category content does not match its own label closely enough to certify as a genuine Bathroom fixture line. Bathroom Stools (rja,zqm,36g) -- sampled titles are generic multi-purpose stools/step-ladders explicitly marketed for 'bedroom-kitchen-living-room-office' use, not bathroom-specific furniture despite the site's own label; primary product type rule (Rule 2) overrides the room-name label. ROUTED TO REVIEW (genuine site-level ambiguity, not guessed, Rule 29): Faucets (b8s,ecr,xpl, header qty 9,610) -- the listing page's own <title> reads 'Kitchen and Bathroom Faucets Online - Flipkart', i.e. the site itself does not split kitchen vs. bathroom faucets into separate URLs; a 'Faucet Category' filter facet exists but its option values are not present in the static HTML (loaded only on click) so no verifiable bathroom-only URL/count exists. Drain Strainers (b8s,ecr,ft0, 9,258) -- sampled titles are dominated by 'kitchen sink' strainers with a minority of 'floor'/'bathroom sink basin' items; genuinely mixed, no split URL. Faucet Extensions (b8s,ecr,lhv, 9,962) -- sampled titles mix kitchen tap extenders with shower-head/faucet items; mixed and internally inconsistent. Bucket Organizers (b8s,ecr,87b, 37) -- sampled titles are unrelated junk (jewelry tray, chalkboard stickers, generic drawers) rather than a coherent bathroom-accessory line. DEDUP: ran the mandatory cross_category_url_index.json check against every one of the 34 URLs recorded in rows[] -- zero hits, none already extracted in Furniture/Storage/Wall_Decor/Textile. No duplicate-link issues found within this company's own tree.
